note: A profile is ONE selection that fills every contract row at once. The kernel resolves the active profile at session start and loads its rows. Selection: read .madewell/profile. Quality is the Jig (`.madewell/jig/`) plus trade conventions if a trade is loaded, else the Rubric asked inline. Trades live outside the kernel install; a project loads one by explicit reference. The door is chosen once at adoption (just talk = guide, show me the engine = lead) and decides only which surfaces the person sees; the work, the one voice and the glossary are the same behind both (AGENTS.md § Host, PROFILES.md § The two doors).

surfaces.conversation: the host's one voice, in the glossary's words
surfaces.brief: the front page: constellation brief, told in the host's words
surfaces.questions: a question with a recommendation, answerable in one word
surfaces.save-line: the plain save line after each step
surfaces.notices: night-shift notices, relayed by the host
surfaces.receipt: the receipt when something is done
surfaces.engine-names: the engine's own name after the plain word, e.g. 'a second look (polaris)'
surfaces.commands: the constellation commands the host runs, shown as it runs them
surfaces.status: constellation status: where every piece is, and its whole run
surfaces.files: the files under .madewell/ and the commit history

lead.for: the owner who holds the project — a solo maintainer + their agent, as peers
lead.quality: jig + trade conventions if present, else Rubric inline
lead.memory: default (flat files: DECISIONS / PRODUCT + git log)

contributor.for: a technical guest folded into an existing project — a contractor / new hire + their agent
contributor.quality: jig + trade conventions if present, else Rubric inline
contributor.authority: surfaces findings to the Lead; stays in lane

guide.for: a person who would rather just talk — often a non-technical builder making their own thing
guide.quality: jig + trade conventions if present, else Rubric inline
guide.authority: owner — every decision is theirs; the system holds the process

naked.for: machines, CI, headless agents — no human present
